PORT.description: Port the RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) S3 API listens on. RustFS binds RUSTFS_ADDRESS (0.0.0.0:9000) baked into its Dockerfile and ignores $PORT, so the domain must name the container port explicitly.

CONSOLE_PORT.description: Port the RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) web console listens on.

MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) root username. RustFS reads this variable natively.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-compatible) root password. RustFS reads this variable natively.
